targets.old_statement: A reversible lane bordered on both sides by double broken yellow lines is the only place a driver may travel left of a yellow line, while a center left-turn lane with solid yellow outside and broken yellow inside is for left turns only.
targets.old_spoken_statement: A reversible lane bordered on both sides by double broken yellow lines is the only place a driver may travel left of a yellow line, while a center left-turn lane with solid yellow outside and broken yellow inside is for left turns only.
targets.statement: A reversible lane marked on both sides by a double yellow broken line is the sole case where a driver may travel any distance left of a yellow line, whereas a center left-turn lane has solid yellow outer lines and broken inner lines for left turns only.

targets.old_statement: The round or diamond yellow sign is the advance warning of a railroad crossing, while the white X crossbuck marks the crossing itself and a sign beneath it counts the tracks when there are two or more.
targets.old_spoken_statement: The round or diamond yellow sign is the advance warning of a railroad crossing, while the white X crossbuck marks the crossing itself and a sign beneath it counts the tracks when there are two or more.
targets.statement: Railroad crossing signs appear either as round or diamond-shaped yellow signs bearing black symbols or as white X-shaped crossbucks bearing black letters, with an added sign below the crossbuck showing the track count when there are two or more.
